name: unchained_berserker_cannot_be_equipped_by_a_white_equipment_but_can_by_others
notes: Printed: 'Protection from white (This creature can't be ... equipped ... by anything white.)'. Ancestral Blade is a white Equipment (Equip {1}), Marauder's Axe a colourless one (Equip {2}, +2/+0). Seat 0 has the mana for both. Equipping the white Blade to the Berserker is refused; equipping the Axe works and stays attached: the Berserker is 3/1 (1/1 plus 2/+0).
